summary.name: V7 Go
summary.one_liner: V7 Go is an enterprise platform for building AI workflows that automate document-heavy processes in private markets, insurance, and real estate.
use_cases: automate investment due diligence on deal documents
insurance underwriting and claims document processing
real estate acquisition and asset data analysis
generate investor-ready tables, slides and docs
monitor earnings calls and filings for funds
invoice and contract review at scale
summary.what_it_does: The page describes V7 Go as a platform that turns hundreds of pages of instructions and document-heavy processes into AI workflows for private markets, insurance, and real estate. It offers a library of pre-built industry AI agents (over 280 are listed) and lets firms create their own. It connects a firm's context sources such as portfolio databases, filings, data rooms, financial models, and market data, with over 300 integrations and MCP or API access. It can generate editable tables, slides, and documents that can be downloaded as PDF or PPTX or saved to Google Drive or SharePoint. The page also lists security features including no training on customer data, end-to-end encryption, and audit logs.
notable: Library of 280+ pre-built industry AI agents, with option to create custom agents
Over 300 integrations and MCP/API access for connecting firm data sources
Exports editable investor materials as PDF, PPTX, or saves to Drive/SharePoint
States it never trains on customer data, with audit logs across workflows
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; it is unclear whether the platform is free or paid.
Much of the page is customer testimonials and marketing claims (e.g., speed and cost savings) that are not independently verified.
The listing in the collective-ai-tools directory describes a different product, V7 Labs' computer vision annotation platform, so this page may not represent that product.
